name: god-of-design
description: Design-intelligence pack for AI agents: 19 skills and 109 world design styles covering UI/UX, web, mobile, social media, branding, print, presentations, motion, data viz and image prompts, with anti-slop gates, WCAG checks and Tailwind/React/SVG output.

interface.shortDescription: Advanced design abilities for coding agents: 109 world styles, every design area, anti-slop gates.
interface.longDescription: 19 skills that turn an agent into a senior designer: a brief → direction → system → build → critique workflow; 109 styles from Swiss, Bauhaus and Art Deco to Ottoman İznik, Islamic geometry, Kente, Madhubani, wabi-sabi, Y2K and liquid glass; color theory with WCAG math; 60 Google Fonts pairings; grids and composition; UI/UX components and design tokens; social media specs for every platform; logos, branding and print; presentations, motion, data viz and image-generation prompts; plus HTML/CSS, Tailwind, React, SVG and Figma/Canva handoff.
defaultPrompt: Design a landing page for an Istanbul ceramics studio in Ottoman İznik style.
Give me three distinct visual directions for my fintech app.
Audit this page for AI slop and accessibility, then fix it.
